headline.zh: AI 同事接管重复性工作

scenario.zh: 访客提供日常业务任务描述，Viktor 返回可执行的自动化流程方案
scenario.en: Visitor provides a routine business task description, Viktor returns an executable automation workflow

instruction.zh: Viktor 将哪类重复工作变成自动流程？
instruction.en: Which repetitive work should Viktor turn into an automated workflow?

output.zh: 检测到 4 个可自动化步骤

input.zh: 新客户填表后，销售手动发欢迎邮件、创建 CRM 记录、安排入职会议、分配客户经理
input.en: After new customer submits form, sales manually sends welcome email, creates CRM record, schedules onboarding call, assigns account manager

output.zh: 表单提交触发：即时发送个性化欢迎邮件、自动创建 CRM 条目并填充字段、检查日历空位并发送会议邀请、根据地区规则分配经理
output.en: Form submission triggers: instant personalized welcome email, auto-create CRM entry with populated fields, check calendar availability and send meeting invite, assign manager based on region rules

detail.zh: 使用客户名称和产品选择生成内容
detail.en: Generate content using customer name and product choice

detail.zh: 映射表单字段到 CRM 对象
detail.en: Map form fields to CRM objects

detail.zh: 查询团队日历并发送邀请链接
detail.en: Query team calendar and send invite link

detail.zh: 应用地区和负载均衡逻辑

output.zh: 提取关键字段并路由审批
output.en: Extract key fields and route for approval

input.zh: 邮件附件：Acme Corp 发票，日期 2024-03-15，总额 €4,850，付款条款 Net 30，项目代码 PRJ-2024-089
input.en: Email attachment: Acme Corp invoice, date 2024-03-15, total €4,850, payment terms Net 30, project code PRJ-2024-089

output.zh: 供应商 Acme Corp、金额 €4,850、到期 2024-04-14、项目 PRJ-2024-089；已路由至财务主管审批队列
output.en: Vendor Acme Corp, amount €4,850, due 2024-04-14, project PRJ-2024-089; routed to finance lead approval queue

output.zh: 识别问题类型并分配专家
output.en: Identify issue type and assign specialist

input.zh: 我们的仪表板加载很慢，尤其是在切换到报告页面时。使用 Chrome 浏览器，已清除缓存但问题依旧。
input.en: Our dashboard loads slowly, especially when switching to the reports page. Using Chrome browser, cleared cache but issue persists.

output.zh: 问题类型：性能 - 前端延迟；优先级：中；分配至前端工程团队；建议初步检查：网络瀑布、包大小
output.en: Issue type: Performance - frontend latency; priority: medium; assigned to frontend engineering team; suggested initial check: network waterfall, bundle size

instruction.zh: Viktor 将这些步骤串联成完整流程
instruction.en: Viktor connects these steps into a complete workflow

output.zh: 显示触发条件、执行顺序和异常处理
output.en: Shows trigger conditions, execution order, and error handling

takeaway.zh: 演示了 Viktor 如何将重复任务转化为自动化流程方案；实际部署、系统集成和执行监控需在 Viktor 平台完成
takeaway.en: Demonstrated how Viktor converts repetitive tasks into automation workflow plans; actual deployment, system integration, and execution monitoring happen on the Viktor platform
